'''Landis''' (Japanese: '''テルヒコ''' ''Teruhiko'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP010|Not on My Watch Ya Don't!]]''. Although he is not old enough to be a real Trainer, he does own a {{p|Shinx}}. He is the son of the [[Pokétch Co. President]].

Landis first appeared when {{an|Dawn}} had just been tricked into taking a free fake [[Pokétch]] from {{TRT}}. He put it under water to show that the paint smeared, meaning it was not the real thing and then took the group to the [[Pokétch Company]].

Landis has some similarities to [[Max]]. He is young but very smart and knows a lot about Pokémon, which he studies about in the {{si|Trainers' School}} in [[Jubilife City]]. Landis also has a similar hair color to Max. He apparently likes to make Dawn angry as even after the episode was over, he said Dawn needed good luck to win the Jubilife {{pkmn|Contest}}.

|desc=Landis's {{p|Shinx}} appeared in ''[[DP010|Not on MY Watch Ya Don't!]]'', where {{Ash}}, {{an|Dawn}}, and {{an|Brock}} had bought fake [[Pokétch]]es from {{TRT}} [[List of Team Rocket's disguises|disguised]] as {{tc|Clown}}s. Shinx noticed Dawn's Pokétch and barked for Landis, prompting him to snatch it off Dawn's wrist and put it under a nearby tap, causing the paints to come off. Landis insisted they come to [[Landis's father|his father]]'s Pokétch Factory. Shinx watched as Landis's father used the {{DL|Pokétch|Friendship Checker|Friendship Checker App}} on {{AP|Pikachu}}, {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}}, and {{TP|Brock|Croagunk}}.

That night in the Factory, Landis was watching his father examining Team Rocket's fake Pokétches as Shinx suddenly wandered off. Minutes later, they met up with Ash, Dawn, and Brock to tell them that Shinx had gone missing. They followed the trail of Pokémon until they found a huge box that all of the Pokémon were getting into, including Shinx. Landis tried to rescue Shinx, but Dawn rescued him from being crushed by the door. Suddenly, they found out that Team Rocket was behind this as they took the box away on their [[Team Rocket's mechas|balloon]].

[[Dawn's Buneary]] launched an {{m|Ice Beam}}, freezing Team Rocket, snapping all of the Pokémon out of {{p|Psyduck}}'s hypnotism, and freeing Shinx. Team Rocket sent out {{TP|James|Carnivine}} and {{TP|Jessie|Seviper}}; Piplup and Buneary finished them off, but Pikachu was left worn out. Shinx decided to use {{m|Spark}} to recharge Pikachu, allowing him to launch a {{m|Thunderbolt}} that sent Team Rocket blasting off.

Shinx's only known move is {{m|Spark}}.}}
